   166	def enumerate_paths(n, edges):
   167	    """All source->destination edge-ID paths of the full DAG (bounded)."""
   168	    m = len(edges)
   169	    ev = [e["v"] for e in edges]
   170	    out = [[] for _ in range(n)]
   171	    for i in range(m):
   172	        out[edges[i]["u"]].append(i)
   173	
   174	    reach = [0] * n            # number of paths from v to node n-1
   175	    reach[n - 1] = 1
   176	    for v in range(n - 2, -1, -1):
   177	        s = 0
   178	        for eid in out[v]:
   179	            s += reach[ev[eid]]
   180	        reach[v] = s
   181	    total = reach[0]
   182	    if total > MAX_PATHS:
   183	        raise Invalid()
   184	
   185	    paths = []
   186	    if total:
   187	        acc = []
   188	
   189	        def dfs(v):
   190	            if v == n - 1:
   191	                paths.append(tuple(acc))
   192	                return
   193	            for eid in out[v]:
   194	                w = ev[eid]
   195	                if reach[w]:
   196	                    acc.append(eid)
   197	                    dfs(w)
   198	                    acc.pop()
   199	
   200	        dfs(0)
   201	    return paths
